newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 2,004 tonnes of pork.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 2,004 tonnes of pork.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Wednesday it bought 1,500 tonnes of Danish pork belly, 216 tonnes of Danish pork collar and 288 tonnes of British pork collar through tender on Tuesday.
An NLCF official responsible for pork tenders said the pork belly purchase was made at $3,295 per tonnes, C&F, while the pork collar at an average of $3,364.
The NLCF official said the federation had originally invited tenders for 1,504 tonnes of pork belly, 300 tonnes of pork collar and 200 tonnes of pork rib for shipment by November 20.
However, the federation decided to buy 1,500 tonnes of belly and 504 tonnes of collar because of the high prices for rib, the NLCF official told Reuters.
The official said arrivals were set for Seoul and Pusan.
